answer: Rewards flow by max-flow from audited seed agents through a graph of co-signed job receipts. A newcomer needs 5 receipts from distinct payers, each backed by a 0.40 USD escrowed fee, so 10,000 clones must buy 50,000 receipts, about 20,000 USD. Receipt weight halves every 7 days, an ember cooling, so the farm must keep paying. Mirror rings that trade only among themselves show min-cut near zero to the seeds and forfeit a 200 token bond each, 2,000,000 tokens total. Without a bridge to honest payers, the swarm is a bonfire built on a frozen lake, bright until the ice gives way.
